scope: Native first-program header-write attribution, MD5 arithmetic and queue worker/wrapper boundaries in synthetic RAM. No physical storage or RTOS scheduling.

trace.event_encoding: VEX memory-write events, not logical store-instruction executions; SWL/SWR may expand into byte events

modeled_prefix.0x80019014: card callback supplies original package bytes
modeled_prefix.0x8008495c: existing-media header returns synthetic installed header
modeled_prefix.0x8008249c: operation 6 fills 16 spare bytes with FF and returns 0; operation 8 returns 0

modeled_worker_wrappers.0x80029fdc: capture three-word queue message and return fixture status
modeled_worker_wrappers.0x80023524: supply next three-word queue message and return fixture status

findings.header: 3242 VEX write events: 170 preceding map/header/MBR events reproduce the final program-source SHA256; 3072 final copy events move the first1536 bytes without further change in this fixture.
findings.map_size: Original +0x214=0x1367b, +0x224=0x982 and rounded code span0xa00 give 0x1367b+0x982-0xa00+3=0x13600. The +3 is an original instruction, not an inferred sector rule.
findings.copied_fields: Installed-header +0x310/+0x314 become640/384; +0x230 and installed[0x318,0x398) copy without final difference. Section0 copies36 bytes to+0x3b0; sections1..6 copy216 bytes to+0x238. Synthetic geometry stores1/0 at+0x3a8/+0x3ac.
findings.partition: MBR base=incoming.u32[0x200]*512=0x400. Section+0xc ID999 or +4 span0 skips. Valid fixture IDs0..3 use16-byte entries at+0x1be. Section+0x14 goes to entry+8; +0x10 goes to entry+12; entry+4=1; only ID0 forces entry+0=0x80.
findings.hash: Original MD5 init/append/finish, compression helper, memcpy and memcmp execute without primitive substitutions. Worker queues/log are modeled. Commands0/1/2 initialize/append/finish; comparison sends3/4; stop5 echoes and exits; unknown command loops.
findings.pointer: Append uses(p|0x80000000) if p&0x40000000, else(p&0xdfffffff). Both branches use separately mapped synthetic addresses; no cache/MMU equivalence claim.
findings.wrapper: Init/Update ignore modeled queue status and return1. Fanalize ignores modeled send/receive status and tests reply word==3. No real RTOS failure or stale-queue behavior claim.

boot_anonymous_ranges.name: MD5 compression helper
boot_anonymous_ranges.extent_basis: Analyst bounds from entry, return and adjacent md5_init STT_FUNC

evidence.role: Native program-buffer writes, one witness per observed instruction
Section map size arithmetic and header destinations
Hash queues, dispatcher and native digest calls
Hash wrapper message words and ignored queue status
MD5 primitive entries and count/padding path

references.title: RFC1321 algorithm and A.5 vectors
references.use: Algorithm and empty/abc vectors only; no security inference.

notes: Comparison uses pinned K-3 III loader and numeric integration evidence; no descriptor, instruction, hash or compression compatibility is inferred.

limitations: Installed header, geometry and FCU results are synthetic; stop at FCU callee entry after JAL/delay slot and before operation5 handling. No physical storage writes.
No full BurnNand recovery loop, RTOS interleavings, actual caches, hardware acceptance, camera boot or capture.
VEX SWL/SWR event count is engine-specific; byte result checked separately. Native field assignments do not identify a filesystem.
Finite synthetic digest inputs; real package hash-flag choice and full-file acceptance remain separate.
Full firmware, resource bytes, decompilation, compiled object and update candidate remain private.
